reason: A static DSH Web UI plugin that applies Claude-inspired light and dark themes and optionally replaces selected DeepSeek interface branding with reversible browser-side changes.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 Claude 风格的明暗主题，并可选地将部分 DeepSeek 界面品牌元素替换为可还原的 Claude 风格。
summaries.en: Applies Claude-inspired light and dark themes to the DSH Web UI and optionally replaces selected DeepSeek interface branding with reversible browser-side changes.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH web interface theme and visual styling
Provides persistent theme and disguise settings
Replaces selected interface branding text, logos, titles, and favicon in the browser UI
Observes interface mutations to reapply reversible visual changes
